q: 他昨天没带钱，今天___没带钱。
zh: 他昨天没带钱，今天又没带钱。
py: tā zuó tiān méi dài qián jīn tiān yòu méi dài qián
en: He didn't bring any money yesterday, and he didn't again today.
why: The repeat of 'didn't bring' is already a fact, so it is 又没. 再 looks forward to a repeat that has not happened yet.

q: 这双球鞋刚修好，今天___坏了。
zh: 这双球鞋刚修好，今天又坏了。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié gāng xiū hǎo jīn tiān yòu huài le
en: These sneakers had just been repaired and broke again today.
why: 今天 plus 了 shows the breakdown has happened, so it is 又. 再 cannot report a repeat that is already over.

q: 明天___是星期一了，我不能去打球了。
zh: 明天又是星期一了，我不能去打球了。
py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le wǒ bù néng qù dǎ qiú le
en: Tomorrow is Monday again, so I can't go and play ball.
why: Mondays come round on schedule, so the speaker uses 又是…了 for a certain recurrence. 再 is for a repeat you ask for or plan.

q: 他今天___输了，已经是第三次了。
zh: 他今天又输了，已经是第三次了。
py: tā jīn tiān yòu shū le yǐ jīng shì dì sān cì le
en: He lost again today; that's already the third time.
why: 输了 and 已经是第三次了 show the repeat has happened, so 又. 再 would suggest he has yet to lose again.

q: 你怎么___买衣服了？上个星期不是刚买过吗？
zh: 你怎么又买衣服了？上个星期不是刚买过吗？
py: nǐ zěn me yòu mǎi yī fu le shàng ge xīng qī bú shì gāng mǎi guo ma
en: Why are you buying clothes again? Didn't you just buy some last week?
why: 怎么 with 了 questions a repeat that has already happened, so 又. 再 is for repeats still to come.

q: 这家店的牛奶上个月刚涨过价，听说下个月___要涨价了。
zh: 这家店的牛奶上个月刚涨过价，听说下个月又要涨价了。
py: zhè jiā diàn de niú nǎi shàng ge yuè gāng zhǎng guo jià tīng shuō xià ge yuè yòu yào zhǎng jià le
en: The shop's milk went up just last month, and I hear it is going up again next month.
why: 又要…了 notes a repeat that is bound to come round, here with a sigh. The speaker is not requesting it, so 再 does not fit.

q: 爸爸今晚___要去踢球了，妈妈有点儿不高兴。
zh: 爸爸今晚又要去踢球了，妈妈有点儿不高兴。
py: bà ba jīn wǎn yòu yào qù tī qiú le mā ma yǒu diǎn r bù gāo xìng
en: Dad is going out to play football again tonight, and Mum is a bit unhappy.
why: 又要…了 reports a routine that comes round again, with the speaker's feeling about it. 再 is for a repeat you plan or ask for.

q: 他的腿刚好一点儿，没想到打球的时候___受伤了。
zh: 他的腿刚好一点儿，没想到打球的时候又受伤了。
py: tā de tuǐ gāng hǎo yī diǎn r méi xiǎng dào dǎ qiú de shí hou yòu shòu shāng le
en: His leg had only just got a bit better, and he never expected to hurt it again while playing.
why: The injury has already happened a second time, so 又 with 了. 再 cannot narrate a past repeat.

q: 这个球太贵了，我们下次___买吧。
zh: 这个球太贵了，我们下次再买吧。
py: zhè ge qiú tài guì le wǒ men xià cì zài mǎi ba
en: This ball is too expensive; let's buy it next time.
why: 下次 and 吧 make this a plan for later, so the action is put off with 再. 又 reports an event that already happened.

q: 老板，请你___说一遍价钱。
zh: 老板，请你再说一遍价钱。
py: lǎo bǎn qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn jià qián
en: Boss, please say the price once more.
why: A request is about something not yet done, so 再. 又 would claim the boss has already repeated it.

q: 比赛输了没关系，下个星期我们___比一次。
zh: 比赛输了没关系，下个星期我们再比一次。
py: bǐ sài shū le méi guān xi xià ge xīng qī wǒ men zài bǐ yī cì
en: Losing doesn't matter; next week we'll play another match.
why: 下个星期 puts the rematch in the future, so 再. 又 would need the rematch to have happened already.

q: 这条裤子我先试试，不合适的话明天___来换。
zh: 这条裤子我先试试，不合适的话明天再来换。
py: zhè tiáo kù zi wǒ xiān shì shi bù hé shì de huà míng tiān zài lái huàn
en: I'll try these trousers on first; if they don't fit I'll come again tomorrow to exchange them.
why: 明天 is future and conditional, so the return trip takes 再. 又 cannot describe a visit that has not happened.

q: 你___试一下这件衣服吧。
zh: 你再试一下这件衣服吧。
py: nǐ zài shì yī xià zhè jiàn yī fu ba
en: Try this piece of clothing on once more.
why: A suggestion with 吧 asks for a repeat that has not happened, so 再. 又 would claim you already did.

q: 如果这次游泳比赛没拿到名次，我明年___参加一次。
zh: 如果这次游泳比赛没拿到名次，我明年再参加一次。
py: rú guǒ zhè cì yóu yǒng bǐ sài méi ná dào míng cì wǒ míng nián zài cān jiā yī cì
en: If I don't place in this swimming race, I'll enter once more next year.
why: 明年 and 如果 make it a plan for the future, so 再. 又 reports repeats that are already facts.

q: 请把这个游戏的规则___讲一遍，我没听懂。
zh: 请把这个游戏的规则再讲一遍，我没听懂。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè ge yóu xì de guī zé zài jiǎng yī biàn wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: Please explain the rules of this game once more; I didn't understand.
why: 请 makes it a request for a repeat that has not happened, so 再. 又 would report a repeat that is done.

q: 价格我们还要商量，下午我___给您打电话。
zh: 价格我们还要商量，下午我再给您打电话。
py: jià gé wǒ men hái yào shāng liang xià wǔ wǒ zài gěi nín dǎ diàn huà
en: We still need to discuss the price; I'll call you again this afternoon.
why: 下午 is still ahead, so the second call is 再. 又 would mean the call has already been made again.

q: 他___在买东西，你等一下。
zh: 他还在买东西，你等一下。
py: tā hái zài mǎi dōng xi nǐ děng yī xià
en: He's still shopping; wait a moment.
why: 还在 + verb says the activity has not stopped. 再 means 'again' and cannot stand before 在.

q: 都十点了，商店___没开门呢。
zh: 都十点了，商店还没开门呢。
py: dōu shí diǎn le shāng diàn hái méi kāi mén ne
en: It's already ten o'clock and the shop still hasn't opened.
why: Something that hasn't happened yet is 还没, and 呢 closes it. 再没 does not express 'still'.

q: 我在网上买的球拍___没到，你的到了吗？
zh: 我在网上买的球拍还没到，你的到了吗？
py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de qiú pāi hái méi dào nǐ de dào le ma
en: The racket I bought online still hasn't arrived; has yours?
why: 还没 shows the situation has not changed. 再没 cannot mean 'still not'.

q: 我换了新球拍，打得___是不好。
zh: 我换了新球拍，打得还是不好。
py: wǒ huàn le xīn qiú pāi dǎ de hái shi bù hǎo
en: I switched to a new racket and I still play badly.
why: 还是 before 不好 means 'still the same' after something that might have changed it. 再是 is not a pattern.

q: 这家店的价格这么多年___是那么便宜。
zh: 这家店的价格这么多年还是那么便宜。
py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé zhè me duō nián hái shi nà me pián yi
en: After so many years this shop's prices are still that cheap.
why: 还是 expresses 'still as before' despite the passing years. 再 means 'again' and gives no such meaning.

q: 外面___在下雨，我们别去跑步了。
zh: 外面还在下雨，我们别去跑步了。
py: wài miàn hái zài xià yǔ wǒ men bié qù pǎo bù le
en: It's still raining outside, so let's not go running.
why: The rain has not stopped, which is 还在. 又在下雨 would mean it has started raining again.

q: 他已经学了三年游泳，可是___没学会换气，教练很着急。
zh: 他已经学了三年游泳，可是还没学会换气，教练很着急。
py: tā yǐ jīng xué le sān nián yóu yǒng kě shì hái méi xué huì huàn qì jiào liàn hěn zháo jí
en: He has studied swimming for three years but still hasn't learned to breathe properly, and the coach is worried.
why: 可是 shows the expected change has not happened: 还没. 又没 would mean he failed again, but he is not repeating anything.

q: 这双袜子还没干___，你别穿。
zh: 这双袜子还没干呢，你别穿。
py: zhè shuāng wà zi hái méi gān ne nǐ bié chuān
en: These socks haven't dried yet, so don't wear them.
why: 还没 describes no change, and 了 marks a change, so 了 clashes. 呢 (or nothing) is the matching particle.

q: 你买了球拍，___想买什么？
zh: 你买了球拍，还想买什么？
py: nǐ mǎi le qiú pāi hái xiǎng mǎi shén me
en: You've bought a racket; what else do you want to buy?
why: 'What else' adds to what is already chosen, which is 还. 又 would sound like a complaint, and 再 cannot come before 想.

q: 他会打篮球，___会踢足球。
zh: 他会打篮球，还会踢足球。
py: tā huì dǎ lán qiú hái huì tī zú qiú
en: He can play basketball, and he can play football too.
why: 还 adds a second skill to the first. 再 means 'again' and does not add a different thing.

q: 你明天___来这家店吗？
zh: 你明天还来这家店吗？
py: nǐ míng tiān hái lái zhè jiā diàn ma
en: Will you come to this shop again tomorrow?
why: A yes/no question about a future repeat takes 还. 再 is used in statements and requests, and 又 reports repeats that already happened.

q: 那家运动用品店你以后___去吗？
zh: 那家运动用品店你以后还去吗？
py: nà jiā yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn nǐ yǐ hòu hái qù ma
en: Will you go to that sports shop again later?
why: With 吗 and a future time, 'again' is 还. 再 does not sit in a plain yes/no question.

q: 这个周末我想去爬山，___想去游泳。
zh: 这个周末我想去爬山，还想去游泳。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù pá shān hái xiǎng qù yóu yǒng
en: This weekend I want to go hiking, and I also want to go swimming.
why: 还 before the modal 想 adds a second wish. 再 goes after the modal and means 'again'.

q: 除了那双跑鞋，我___想看看有没有合适的运动衣。
zh: 除了那双跑鞋，我还想看看有没有合适的运动衣。
py: chú le nà shuāng pǎo xié wǒ hái xiǎng kàn kan yǒu méi yǒu hé shì de yùn dòng yī
en: Besides those running shoes, I also want to see whether there is suitable sportswear.
why: 除了…还 adds another item to the one already named, and 还 stands before the modal 想. 再想 is the wrong order.

q: 除了水果，我们___要买米。
zh: 除了水果，我们还要买米。
py: chú le shuǐ guǒ wǒ men hái yào mǎi mǐ
en: Besides fruit, we also need to buy rice.
why: 除了…还 adds an extra item. 再 means 'again' and cannot do this.

q: 我想___去一次那家体育用品店。
zh: 我想再去一次那家体育用品店。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài qù yī cì nà jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
en: I want to go to that sports shop once more.
why: 再 follows the modal 想 and stands right before the repeated verb 去. 还 and 又 would have to come before 想.

q: 这家店的鞋很不错，我下次___想来。
zh: 这家店的鞋很不错，我下次还想来。
py: zhè jiā diàn de xié hěn bú cuò wǒ xià cì hái xiǎng lái
en: The shoes in this shop are quite good; I'd like to come again next time.
why: With 想 after the blank, the adverb in front of the modal is 还. 再想来 puts 再 before the modal, which is the wrong order.

q: 他___想喝咖啡了，刚才不是喝过了吗？
zh: 他又想喝咖啡了，刚才不是喝过了吗？
py: tā yòu xiǎng hē kā fēi le gāng cái bú shì hē guo le ma
en: He wants coffee again? Didn't he just have some?
why: A wish that has come back already is 又 before the modal, with 了. 再 cannot stand before 想.

q: 你想___吃一点儿吗？
zh: 你想再吃一点儿吗？
py: nǐ xiǎng zài chī yī diǎn r ma
en: Do you want to eat a bit more?
why: After the modal 想, the word for 'more' is 再, right before the verb. 还 and 又 cannot follow 想.

q: 这件衣服不合适，我得___来一次。
zh: 这件衣服不合适，我得再来一次。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu bù hé shì wǒ děi zài lái yī cì
en: This piece of clothing doesn't fit; I'll have to come one more time.
why: The coming back is still ahead and follows the modal 得 (děi), so it is 再 right before 来. 又 reports a past repeat.

q: 这场球赛太精彩了，我___想___看一遍。
zh: 这场球赛太精彩了，我还想再看一遍。
py: zhè chǎng qiú sài tài jīng cǎi le wǒ hái xiǎng zài kàn yī biàn
en: That match was so exciting that I'd like to watch it once more.
why: The order is 还 before the modal and 再 after it: 还想再看. Reversing them or using 再 twice is wrong.

q: 价钱我没听清楚，您能___说一遍吗？
zh: 价钱我没听清楚，您能再说一遍吗？
py: jià qián wǒ méi tīng qīng chu nín néng zài shuō yī biàn ma
en: I didn't catch the price; could you say it once more?
why: The repeat is a request that has not happened, and it comes after the modal 能: 能再说. 还 cannot follow 能 here.

q: 虽然已经买了三个球，他___想___买两个，因为大家都要用。
zh: 虽然已经买了三个球，他还想再买两个，因为大家都要用。
py: suī rán yǐ jīng mǎi le sān ge qiú tā hái xiǎng zài mǎi liǎng ge yīn wèi dà jiā dōu yào yòng
en: Although he has already bought three balls, he'd like to buy two more because everyone needs them.
why: 还 goes before the modal 想 (adding to what he has) and 再 goes after it, before 买. Doubling 还 or swapping the order is wrong.

q: 我们先吃饭，___去买球鞋吧。
zh: 我们先吃饭，再去买球鞋吧。
py: wǒ men xiān chī fàn zài qù mǎi qiú xié ba
en: Let's eat first and then go and buy sneakers.
why: 先 sets up the first step and 再 the second step of a plan. 又 would mean the second step is already done.

q: 你先付钱，___拿东西。
zh: 你先付钱，再拿东西。
py: nǐ xiān fù qián zài ná dōng xi
en: Pay first, then take your things.
why: The order of two planned actions is 先…再…. 又 reports something already done twice.

q: 这件事我们等老板回来___说吧。
zh: 这件事我们等老板回来再说吧。
py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ men děng lǎo bǎn huí lái zài shuō ba
en: Let's talk about this when the boss comes back.
why: 等…再 puts the action off until a condition is met, so 再 before 说. 又 does not mean 'then'.

q: 你先试试，合适___买。
zh: 你先试试，合适再买。
py: nǐ xiān shì shi hé shì zài mǎi
en: Try it first, and buy it if it fits.
why: 先 starts a plan and 再 puts the buying after the fitting. 又 and 还 do not create a 'then' sequence.

q: 运动以后别马上喝冷水，休息一会儿___喝。
zh: 运动以后别马上喝冷水，休息一会儿再喝。
py: yùn dòng yǐ hòu bié mǎ shàng hē lěng shuǐ xiū xi yī huì r zài hē
en: After exercise don't drink cold water right away; rest a while before drinking.
why: 再 delays the drinking until after the rest, as advice. 又 would describe a past event.

q: 我们先看看价格，___决定买哪个，别着急付钱。
zh: 我们先看看价格，再决定买哪个，别着急付钱。
py: wǒ men xiān kàn kan jià gé zài jué dìng mǎi nǎ ge bié zháo jí fù qián
en: Let's look at the prices first and then decide which to buy; don't rush to pay.
why: 先…再 gives the planned order of looking and deciding. 又 is for repeats already done, and 还 adds nothing about order.

q: 我们___做热身运动，___开始跑步。
zh: 我们先做热身运动，再开始跑步。
py: wǒ men xiān zuò rè shēn yùn dòng zài kāi shǐ pǎo bù
en: Let's do warm-up exercises first and only then start running.
why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the second step of a plan, both after the subject. Swapping them reverses the meaning, and 又 does not mean 'then'.

q: 我___也不去那家商店了。
zh: 我再也不去那家商店了。
py: wǒ zài yě bú qù nà jiā shāng diàn le
en: I'm never going to that shop again.
why: 'Never again' is the fixed frame 再也不. 又 and 还 cannot replace 再 in it.

q: 那个顾客走了以后，___也没回来过。
zh: 那个顾客走了以后，再也没回来过。
py: nà ge gù kè zǒu le yǐ hòu zài yě méi huí lái guo
en: After that customer left, he never came back.
why: 'Has not happened again since then' is 再也没…过, with 再 before 也. 又也 and 还也 do not exist.

q: 那次受伤以后，他再也___打过篮球。
zh: 那次受伤以后，他再也没打过篮球。
py: nà cì shòu shāng yǐ hòu tā zài yě méi dǎ guo lán qiú
en: Since that injury he has never played basketball again.
why: The time frame is the past, since the injury, with 过, so 没. 再也不 looks forward from now.

q: 我买了一次就后悔了，以后再也___买这个牌子了。
zh: 我买了一次就后悔了，以后再也不买这个牌子了。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī cì jiù hòu huǐ le yǐ hòu zài yě bù mǎi zhè ge pái zi le
en: I regretted it after buying once and will never buy this brand again.
why: 以后 and 了 express a decision from now on, so 再也不. 没 would report that it has not happened since.

q: 这个游戏太难了，我再也___玩了。
zh: 这个游戏太难了，我再也不玩了。
py: zhè ge yóu xì tài nán le wǒ zài yě bù wán le
en: This game is too hard; I'm never playing it again.
why: A decision about the future ends in 不…了, so 再也不玩了. 没玩了 does not fit.

q: 自从搬家以后，他再也___去过那个游泳馆。
zh: 自从搬家以后，他再也没去过那个游泳馆。
py: zì cóng bān jiā yǐ hòu tā zài yě méi qù guo nà ge yóu yǒng guǎn
en: Since moving house he has never been to that swimming pool again.
why: 自从 sets a past start and 过 reports experience, so 再也没. 再也不去过 is not possible.

q: 他输了比赛，再___不想打球了。
zh: 他输了比赛，再也不想打球了。
py: tā shū le bǐ sài zài yě bù xiǎng dǎ qiú le
en: He lost the match and doesn't want to play ball ever again.
why: The fixed frame is 再也不, with 也 right after 再. 再又 and 再还 do not exist.

q: 这家店的衣服___便宜___好看。
zh: 这家店的衣服又便宜又好看。
py: zhè jiā diàn de yī fu yòu pián yi yòu hǎo kàn
en: The clothes in this shop are both cheap and good-looking.
why: Two qualities at once are 又A又B. 再…再 and 还…还 do not pair adjectives this way.

q: 运动以后，我又累又___。
zh: 运动以后，我又累又渴。
py: yùn dòng yǐ hòu wǒ yòu lèi yòu kě
en: After exercise I'm both tired and thirsty.
why: Inside 又…又 the adjectives stand bare, and both sides agree in direction. 很 cannot be added, and 不渴 breaks the pairing.

q: 这个背包___轻___漂亮，所以很多人买。
zh: 这个背包又轻又漂亮，所以很多人买。
py: zhè ge bēi bāo yòu qīng yòu piào liang suǒ yǐ hěn duō rén mǎi
en: This backpack is both light and pretty, so many people buy it.
why: 'Both A and B' is 又轻又漂亮. 还…还 and 再…再 are not used to join two qualities.

q: 孩子们在球场上又___又___，玩得特别开心。
zh: 孩子们在球场上又跑又跳，玩得特别开心。
py: hái zi men zài qiú chǎng shàng yòu pǎo yòu tiào wán de tè bié kāi xīn
en: The children ran and jumped on the field and had a great time.
why: 又…又 joins two actions happening together with bare verbs. 很 cannot go before a verb here, and 再 is not a partner for 又.

q: 这件外套___大___厚，夏天穿太热了。
zh: 这件外套又大又厚，夏天穿太热了。
py: zhè jiàn wài tào yòu dà yòu hòu xià tiān chuān tài rè le
en: This coat is both big and thick, and far too hot to wear in summer.
why: Two qualities that point the same way take 又…又 with no 很. 再 and 还 cannot link them.

q: 这些苹果又大又___，买一点儿吧。
zh: 这些苹果又大又甜，买一点儿吧。
py: zhè xiē píng guǒ yòu dà yòu tián mǎi yī diǎn r ba
en: These apples are big and sweet; let's buy some.
why: The second adjective after 又 stays bare. 很甜 and 最甜 add a degree word, which 又…又 does not allow.

q: 老板，能不能___便宜一点儿？
zh: 老板，能不能再便宜一点儿？
py: lǎo bǎn néng bù néng zài pián yi yī diǎn r
en: Boss, can it be a little cheaper?
why: Asking for a bit more of a quality is 再 + adjective + 一点儿. 又 and 还 do not go before a single adjective.

q: 这件有点儿小，我想试试___大一点儿的。
zh: 这件有点儿小，我想试试再大一点儿的。
py: zhè jiàn yǒu diǎn r xiǎo wǒ xiǎng shì shi zài dà yī diǎn r de
en: This one is a bit small; I'd like to try a slightly bigger one.
why: The wish is for a bit more size, so 再 stands before 大 and 一点儿 follows. 又 and 还 cannot do this.

q: 您说得太快了，请说得___慢一点儿。
zh: 您说得太快了，请说得再慢一点儿。
py: nín shuō de tài kuài le qǐng shuō de zài màn yī diǎn r
en: You speak too fast; please speak a little more slowly.
why: The request for a bit more slowness is 再慢一点儿. 又慢 would describe something already slow.

q: 这个球有点儿硬，我想要一个___软一点儿的。
zh: 这个球有点儿硬，我想要一个再软一点儿的。
py: zhè ge qiú yǒu diǎn r yìng wǒ xiǎng yào yī ge zài ruǎn yī diǎn r de
en: This ball is a bit hard; I'd like one that is a little softer.
why: 再 + adjective + 一点儿 asks for a bit more of a quality than what is in front of you. 又 and 还 are not used here.

q: 这个游泳池的水还是太冷了，能不能把水温调得___高一点儿？
zh: 这个游泳池的水还是太冷了，能不能把水温调得再高一点儿？
py: zhè ge yóu yǒng chí de shuǐ hái shi tài lěng le néng bù néng bǎ shuǐ wēn tiáo de zài gāo yī diǎn r
en: The water in this pool is still too cold; can the temperature be set a little higher?
why: After 调得 the request for a bit more heat is 再高一点儿. 又 and 还 cannot modify an adjective this way.

q: 这双鞋的颜色有点儿深，我想看看___浅一点儿的。
zh: 这双鞋的颜色有点儿深，我想看看再浅一点儿的。
py: zhè shuāng xié de yán sè yǒu diǎn r shēn wǒ xiǎng kàn kan zài qiǎn yī diǎn r de
en: The colour of these shoes is a bit dark; I'd like to see a slightly lighter pair.
why: 'A bit more light' is 再浅一点儿. 又 and 还 do not go before the adjective in this frame.

zh: 我想再打一场篮球。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài dǎ yī chǎng lán qiú
en: I want to play another game of basketball.
why: 再 belongs to the repeated action, so it follows the modal 想 and stands before 打. 再想 puts it before the modal, which is wrong.

zh: 他还想买一双球鞋。
py: tā hái xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng qiú xié
en: He also wants to buy a pair of sneakers.
why: 还 adds a further wish and goes before the modal 想. After 想 it would be 再, which means 'again' instead.

zh: 他又想买新球拍了。
py: tā yòu xiǎng mǎi xīn qiú pāi le
en: He wants to buy a new racket again.
why: A wish that has come back is 又 before the modal 想, with 了 at the end. 想又买 is the wrong order.

zh: 我们先热身再开始比赛。
py: wǒ men xiān rè shēn zài kāi shǐ bǐ sài
en: We warm up first and then start the match.
why: 先 and 再 follow the subject and sit directly before their verbs: 先热身，再开始. They cannot come before 我们.

zh: 你先换衣服再去游泳。
py: nǐ xiān huàn yī fu zài qù yóu yǒng
en: Change your clothes first, then go swimming.
why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the second step of a plan. Both are adverbs after the subject.

zh: 我再也不买这个牌子了。
py: wǒ zài yě bù mǎi zhè ge pái zi le
en: I will never buy this brand again.
why: The frame is 再也不 + verb: 再也 comes right before 不, and 了 closes the decision. The brand may also be fronted as a topic.

zh: 这个背包又轻又便宜。
py: zhè ge bēi bāo yòu qīng yòu pián yi
en: This backpack is both light and cheap.
why: 又 comes before each adjective and the adjectives stay bare. Adding 很 would break the 又…又 pattern.

zh: 我想买一个再大一点儿的球。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī ge zài dà yī diǎn r de qiú
en: I want to buy a slightly bigger ball.
why: 再 stands right before the adjective 大, with 一点儿 after it. The whole phrase modifies 球 through 的.

zh: 他今天又输了。
py: tā jīn tiān yòu shū le
en: He lost again today.
why: The loss has already happened a second time, so 又 goes before the verb with 了 at the end. The time word may come before or after 他.

zh: 他还在商店里买东西。
py: tā hái zài shāng diàn lǐ mǎi dōng xi
en: He is still shopping in the shop.
why: 还 goes before the place phrase that starts with 在 to say the shopping has not stopped. 在商店里 stays before 买.

src_py: lǎo bǎn shuō le yī biàn jià qián
task: Make it a request: ask the boss to say it once more.
zh: 请老板再说一遍价钱。
py: qǐng lǎo bǎn zài shuō yī biàn jià qián
en: Please ask the boss to say the price once more.
why: A request for a repeat that has not happened takes 再, and the count 一遍 follows the verb. 又 would only report what already happened.

src_py: wǒ men pǎo bù rán hòu yóu yǒng
zh: 我们先跑步再游泳。
py: wǒ men xiān pǎo bù zài yóu yǒng
en: We run first and then swim.
why: 先 and 再 turn 'then' into a plan: first action after 先, second after 再, both after the subject.

src: 这双鞋很便宜，也很舒服。
src_py: zhè shuāng xié hěn pián yi yě hěn shū fu
zh: 这双鞋又便宜又舒服。
py: zhè shuāng xié yòu pián yi yòu shū fu
en: These shoes are both cheap and comfortable.
why: 又A又B joins two qualities and the adjectives stay bare, so 很 and 也 are dropped.

src: 我不想再去那家球馆了。
src_py: wǒ bù xiǎng zài qù nà jiā qiú guǎn le
zh: 我再也不想去那家球馆了。
py: wǒ zài yě bù xiǎng qù nà jiā qiú guǎn le
en: I never want to go to that sports hall again.
why: 'Never again' is 再也 + 不想, with 再也 before 不. The hall may also be fronted as the topic.

src_py: zhè ge qiú pāi tài zhòng le
task: Ask whether there is a slightly lighter one: 有没有…的？
zh: 有没有再轻一点儿的？
py: yǒu méi yǒu zài qīng yī diǎn r de
en: Do you have a slightly lighter one?
why: Asking for a bit more of a quality is 再 + adjective + 一点儿, placed before 的. 又 and 还 do not work here.

s: 昨天我再买了一双球鞋。
s_py: zuó tiān wǒ zài mǎi le yī shuāng qiú xié
zh: 昨天我又买了一双球鞋。
py: zuó tiān wǒ yòu mǎi le yī shuāng qiú xié
en: I bought a pair of sneakers again yesterday.
why: 昨天 and 了 show the repeat is already a fact, so it needs 又. 再 cannot report a past repeat.

s: 老板，请又给我一个袋子。
s_py: lǎo bǎn qǐng yòu gěi wǒ yī ge dài zi
zh: 老板，请再给我一个袋子。
py: lǎo bǎn qǐng zài gěi wǒ yī ge dài zi
en: Boss, please give me another bag.
why: A request is about something that has not happened, so it takes 再. 又 reports a repeat that is already done.

s: 他再在店里买东西，你等等他。
s_py: tā zài zài diàn lǐ mǎi dōng xi nǐ děng deng tā
zh: 他还在店里买东西，你等等他。
py: tā hái zài diàn lǐ mǎi dōng xi nǐ děng deng tā
en: He's still shopping in the shop, so wait for him.
why: 'Still doing something' is 还在. 再 means 'again' and never combines with 在 to mean 'still'.

s: 球赛还没开始了。
s_py: qiú sài hái méi kāi shǐ le
zh: 球赛还没开始呢。
py: qiú sài hái méi kāi shǐ ne
en: The match still hasn't started.
why: 还没 says nothing has changed yet, while 了 marks a change, so they clash. The matching particle is 呢.

s: 我再想买一双新球鞋。
s_py: wǒ zài xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng xīn qiú xié
zh: 我想再买一双新球鞋。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài mǎi yī shuāng xīn qiú xié
en: I want to buy another pair of new sneakers.
why: 再 belongs to the repeated buying, so it must follow the modal 想 and stand before 买. 再 before 想 is the wrong order.

s: 我们先看球赛，又去吃饭吧。
s_py: wǒ men xiān kàn qiú sài yòu qù chī fàn ba
zh: 我们先看球赛，再去吃饭吧。
py: wǒ men xiān kàn qiú sài zài qù chī fàn ba
en: Let's watch the match first and then go and eat.
why: 先 pairs with 再 for the second step of a plan. The meal has not happened yet, so 又 is impossible.

s: 这个球队太差了，我又也不看他们的比赛了。
s_py: zhè ge qiú duì tài chà le wǒ yòu yě bù kàn tā men de bǐ sài le
zh: 这个球队太差了，我再也不看他们的比赛了。
py: zhè ge qiú duì tài chà le wǒ zài yě bù kàn tā men de bǐ sài le
en: This team is so bad that I'll never watch their matches again.
why: 'Never again' is the fixed frame 再也不, which looks forward from now. 又也不 does not exist.

s: 这个篮球又很大又很重。
s_py: zhè ge lán qiú yòu hěn dà yòu hěn zhòng
zh: 这个篮球又大又重。
py: zhè ge lán qiú yòu dà yòu zhòng
en: This basketball is both big and heavy.
why: Inside 又…又 the adjectives stay bare, so 很 cannot be added on either side.

s: 这个价钱太高了，能不能又低一点儿？
s_py: zhè ge jià qián tài gāo le néng bù néng yòu dī yī diǎn r
zh: 这个价钱太高了，能不能再低一点儿？
py: zhè ge jià qián tài gāo le néng bù néng zài dī yī diǎn r
en: This price is too high; can it be a little lower?
why: Asking for a bit more of a quality is 再 + adjective + 一点儿. 又 cannot go before a single adjective.

s: 上次吵架以后，她再也不来过这家店。
s_py: shàng cì chǎo jià yǐ hòu tā zài yě bù lái guo zhè jiā diàn
zh: 上次吵架以后，她再也没来过这家店。
py: shàng cì chǎo jià yǐ hòu tā zài yě méi lái guo zhè jiā diàn
en: Since the last quarrel she has never come to this shop again.
why: The time frame is the past, since the quarrel, and 过 marks experience, so it is 再也没…过. 不…过 does not combine.

s: 下个月又要发工资了，大家都想买新手机。
zh: 下个月又要发工资了，大家都想买新手机。
py: xià ge yuè yòu yào fā gōng zī le dà jiā dōu xiǎng mǎi xīn shǒu jī
en: Payday comes round again next month, and everyone wants to buy a new phone.
why: Although it is in the future, payday is certain to come round, so 又要…了 is correct here.

s: 你明天还来打球吗？
zh: 你明天还来打球吗？
py: nǐ míng tiān hái lái dǎ qiú ma
en: Will you come to play ball again tomorrow?
why: A yes/no question about a future repeat takes 还, not 再. This sentence is correct.

s: 现在商店还没关门呢，我们快去吧。
zh: 现在商店还没关门呢，我们快去吧。
py: xiàn zài shāng diàn hái méi guān mén ne wǒ men kuài qù ba
en: The shop still hasn't closed, so let's hurry.
why: 还没…呢 is the right pairing for 'still hasn't'. The 呢 is correct and 了 would be wrong.

s: 我想再去一次那家球馆。
zh: 我想再去一次那家球馆。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài qù yī cì nà jiā qiú guǎn
en: I want to go to that sports hall once more.
why: 再 follows the modal 想 and stands before 去, which is the correct order.

s: 这双鞋我还想再试一次。
zh: 这双鞋我还想再试一次。
py: zhè shuāng xié wǒ hái xiǎng zài shì yī cì
en: I'd like to try these shoes on one more time.
why: 还 before the modal 想 and 再 after it can appear together. This sentence is correct.

s: 吃完饭再走吧，外面的雨太大了。
zh: 吃完饭再走吧，外面的雨太大了。
py: chī wán fàn zài zǒu ba wài miàn de yǔ tài dà le
en: Let's leave after we finish eating; the rain outside is too heavy.
why: 再 alone can put an action off until a condition is met, so 吃完饭再走 is correct without 先.

s: 我再也不想吃那家店的蛋糕了。
zh: 我再也不想吃那家店的蛋糕了。
py: wǒ zài yě bù xiǎng chī nà jiā diàn de dàn gāo le
en: I never want to eat that shop's cake again.
why: 再也不想 with 了 expresses 'never again' from now on, and is correct with the modal after 也.

s: 这家店的老板又会修鞋又会做鞋。
zh: 这家店的老板又会修鞋又会做鞋。
py: zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn yòu huì xiū xié yòu huì zuò xié
en: The owner of this shop can both repair shoes and make them.
why: 又…又 can join two verb phrases, each with its own 会. This sentence is correct.

s: 这条裤子有点儿长，有没有再短一点儿的？
zh: 这条裤子有点儿长，有没有再短一点儿的？
py: zhè tiáo kù zi yǒu diǎn r cháng yǒu méi yǒu zài duǎn yī diǎn r de
en: These trousers are a bit long; do you have a slightly shorter pair?
why: 再 + adjective + 一点儿 asks for a bit more of a quality. This sentence is correct.

s: 试了三双，他还是觉得不合适。
zh: 试了三双，他还是觉得不合适。
py: shì le sān shuāng tā hái shi jué de bù hé shì
en: He tried on three pairs and still feels they don't fit.
why: 还是 before a verb means 'still, as before' despite the attempts. This sentence is correct.
